question: Which of the following classical languages is known as the 'Italian of the East' as all words in this language end with vowel sound?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telugu**__**.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Telugu belongs to the** family of Dravidian languages** and is the** official language of the state of Andhra Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is also one among **23 official national** languages of India.
 
• 19th-century Englishmen called it the 'Italia
